issues.explanation: npx commands without a version suffix (e.g. @1.0.0) create a rug-pull risk if the upstream server is compromised and publishes a malicious update.
Dependencies lack version pinning, allowing potential malicious package updates. Consider pinning versions.
issues.remediation: Pin all dependency versions in requirements.txt or pyproject.toml. Use exact versions (==) or compatible ranges. Run pip-audit regularly.
